correctness.rationale: For any clade of k leaves edge survival probability is 1-q^k; summing gives total (2n-2)-nq-sum c_k q^k. Rooted unordered tree recursion exhausts n<=11, with profile deduplication. Fresh independent exact rational polynomial/Sturm census produced shape counts 11,23,46,98,207 for n7..11 and profiles 11,23,45,95,194; at n11 among 18721 profile pairs exactly 15 have two roots (others 15400 zero and 3306 one), none before n11. Witness -q^2(1-q)(q²+q-1)(q³+q-1) has two distinct simple roots; common-root leaf grafting preserves the gap for all n>11. All roots and counts exact, no floating-point root certification.

value.rationale: The minimum number of tips necessary for repeated reversals is a motivated sharp structural boundary for comparing expected diversity under variable extinction risk. The complete first-layer response-profile-pair census is an independently useful exact invariant, not a rote model restatement.

final_claim: For rooted nonplane full binary shapes with unit edges and iid identical extinction risk q, two strict reversals between expected total surviving PD curves first occur at n=11; exactly 15 unordered distinct profile pairs at n=11 have two crossings; explicit factorized witness extends to all n>11.
limitations: Only unit-length rooted full binary trees with homogeneous independent extinction; larger n only existence, not count.
